Description: Satu (1) drum minyak terpakai didapati tanpa label semasa pemeriksaan pada 8 Okt 2026.
Requirement: All scheduled waste containers must be labelled with waste code, date of generation and generator details.
Reference: EQ (Scheduled Wastes) Regulations 2005, Reg. 8; SW code [SAHKAN RUJUKAN]
Corrective Action Required: Label drum dengan kod SW, tarikh penjanaan dan butiran syarikat. Semak semua bekas lain di stor.

Description: Pintu stor buangan terjadual didapati tidak berkunci semasa pemeriksaan.
Requirement: Scheduled waste storage area must be secured and access restricted to authorised personnel only.
Reference: EQ (Scheduled Wastes) Regulations 2005, Reg. 9; DOE storage guidelines [SAHKAN RUJUKAN]
Corrective Action Required: Pastikan pintu stor sentiasa berkunci. Tetapkan pemegang kunci yang dibenarkan sahaja.

Description: Spill kit di stor didapati kosong; tiada bahan penyerap atau peralatan tumpahan.
Requirement: Spill response equipment must be available and maintained for immediate use.
Reference: EQ (Scheduled Wastes) Regulations 2005, Reg. 10; ISO 14001:2015 Cl. 8.2
Corrective Action Required: Isi semula spill kit dengan segera. Wujudkan semakan bulanan spill kit.

Description: Log inventori buangan terjadual kali terakhir dikemas kini pada bulan September 2026.
Requirement: Scheduled waste inventory must be updated on every generation and removal, and tally with eSWIS records.
Corrective Action Required: Kemas kini log inventori dan padankan dengan rekod eSWIS.

Description: Dua (2) operator didapati tidak memakai pelindung telinga (ear plug) di kawasan bising.
Requirement: Employees must wear hearing protection provided in designated noise areas.
Reference: OSHA 1994, Sec. 24(1)(c); OSH (Noise Exposure) Regulations 2019 [SAHKAN RUJUKAN]
Corrective Action Required: Beri teguran dan taklimat semula PPE kepada operator. Supervisor pantau pematuhan setiap syif.
